summary: This is not a call. It is a solo personal travel vlog recorded in Polish and captured by the meeting recorder under a Zoom meeting title. There is no prospect, no second participant and no sales or company content of any kind. He then describes the day's drive from Czechia through Austria to Bled in Slovenia, roughly five and a quarter hours, abandoning his plan to record dashcam timelapses through Austria after reading that continuous in-car recording carries heavy fines there. The remainder covers fuel prices, the difficulty and cost of finding accommodation near Bled at the start of the season, and his intention to look for a first-come-first-served campsite or sleep in the car or a tent. Mongolia is mentioned as a later leg.
